comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f. The harmonic and subharmonic knobs index an array of the base-two logarithms of 1 to 96, added and subtracted in the exponent, which is what makes the two numbers a frequency ratio. The fine knob runs 0.97 to 1.03 and its value minus one is added as volts, so its range is 0.03V, 36 cents, despite the maker displaying it as a percentage. A mixture takes the channels from four times its number minus four up to four times its number. The maker's manual describes this module as a rebuild of a vintage metronome, which is a copy-paste mistake in the manual. The panel prints Mixture and the maker's tooltips say Mixtur. The gate and retrigger outputs are written whether or not they are patched, and the sixteen per-channel outputs only while they are.
